column3: Decision record: a contender takes over a <file>.lock whose recorded holder is proven gone (ESRCH from a signal-0 probe), serialising contenders on a claim file named by SHA-256 of the lock record and re-probing the PID under the claim; incomplete/own-PID/other-user records are waited for, and the Plugin Manager run.json covers the 'processes it started' gap.

Decision record: Windows file opens go to explorer.exe as ONE argv element with a file URI whose commas and equals are percent-encoded (nothing else, since Explorer rejects encoded non-ASCII); Explorer exit code 1 is accepted as delegation, and the note proves exit 1 does not certify the target because the raw-comma control opened Documents and still exited 1.

Decision record: one idle submission keeps one display owner (Chat echo, then durable message); the echo is hidden by rpcId in the same render and the suppression identity is retained until the Inbox projection watermark passes the claim sequence, so a late projection cannot duplicate it; no new Snapshot field, Host event or persisted format.

Decision record: transcript clipping uses overflow-y:clip (not hidden) so no scroll container is created and sticky headers keep their real scrollport; floating controls are siblings of the clipped root; one follow controller per scrollport, with native animation progress kept separate from reader movement.

Chinese translation of the lock-takeover decision, structurally a full mirror (same four sections, same five consequences, same identifiers in Latin script) - read in full for fidelity, not summarised.
Chinese translation of the Explorer-handoff decision, same measurements and the same bolded negative control (wrong target opened Documents and still exited 1).

Decision record: a pnpm run completes on the raw child's exit event (not pipe EOF), the pipes then drain under a fixed 2000ms grace, and a captured run silent for idleTimeoutMs is killed and classified timeout so it cannot hold the profile lock forever; whole process tree is stopped and awaited before rollback.
Chinese translation of the display-ownership decision, same five decision bullets and same six-row evidence table.
Chinese translation of the bounded-pnpm decision, including the dedicated silence-vs-duration justification section.
Chinese translation of the clipping/follow-ownership decision; note it titles its last section 影响 where the English uses Consequences (heading drift the pair hash would catch).

Decision record: the persistent pwsh tool stops installing its own prompt function (which overwrote the backend's controlled 'dsh> ' and cost 8493ms vs 1340ms per call); the backend owns the constant, the tool must not import it, and the regression asserts the settle reason (>=6 stdin_read, 0 inferred_idle) rather than a duration.
Chinese translation of the controlled-prompt decision; note it keeps four English section headings untranslated (drift for a future one-sided edit).

Decision record: the V3->V4 migration backfills a parent catalog entry only when exactly one supported own child descriptor exists; other descriptor counts keep unknown-mode membership instead of refusing the parent, and missing discovery fields are never inferred into durable facts.
Chinese translation of the incomplete-child-catalog decision; same three rejected alternatives (refuse parent, pick first/last descriptor, infer fields).

Decision record: ToolDefinition.projectContent installs MCP-prepared images BEFORE post-execute policy, the result budget is priced in estimated tokens (12,500, replacing a 50,000-byte setting) with images priced by the active route's calculator, and the spill file keeps readable attachment paths so an omitted image can be re-read.
Chinese translation of the multimodal retention decision; same budget, same indivisible-image and contiguous-ends rules.

Decision record: the Windows mandatory-update overlay becomes a shell-origin frame in the single native window, and update actions are authorised only by a private MessageChannel port transferred to that frame, because window-event source/origin are constructible by product scripts; the overlay is explicitly not a tamper-proof surface.
Chinese translation of the embedded mandatory-update decision; macOS keeps its native overlay.
